_comment: Shared gfx1250 fp8 sweep settings. The shapes extend this and add only
traits: a scalar is pinned, a list is swept. 'screening' gives each swept
trait its stage-1 value -- it does not limit what stage 2 can win, it
decides which geometries reach stage 2 at all. Stage 1 ranks all
geometries under the pin and keeps the best; a geometry cut there is never
seen again. Pinning matters most for lds_k_pad, where the choice moves a
geometry's time by 3x-9x; measured, the epilogue pin changes nothing.
tdm_depth 2 is pinned because it is what ships -- measured ahead of no-TDM
and of depths 1, 3 and 4. Revisit with --set traits.tdm_depth=N, which
pins rather than sweeps, so stage 1 screens at the depth you ask for.
benchmark.workers is build parallelism only, measured flat from 16 to 128
on a 256-core host, so it is shared rather than set per shape.
